item.title: $733M Budget, 4% Tax Hike Proposed
item.description: Mayor Justin Elicker unveiled a budget proposal Friday afternoon that would see the general fund increase by 4.4 percent -- and the tax rate jump by 4.01 percent -- thanks in part to the rising costs of debt service, employee healthcare, and teacher and police salaries, as well as $5 million more for schools. The post $733M Budget, 4% Tax Hike Proposed appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Yale Buys Hull’s Building For $2.4M
item.description: Yale University has bought the Hull's Art Supply building -- one of the few independently owned storefronts near the corner of Chapel and York streets -- for $2.4 million. Owner Shawn Szirbik has a message for customers: "Nothing is changing." The post Yale Buys Hull’s Building For $2.4M appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Late Detective’s Wife Boosts Alder’s Compensation Quest
item.description: HARTFORD -- The widow of a New Haven detective came forward Friday to back up allegations that her husband repeatedly threatened and pressured witnesses, leading to multiple wrongful convictions. She testified about that misconduct in support of Alder Troy Streater’s pursuit of wrongful-conviction compensation from the state. The post Late Detective’s Wife Boosts Alder’s Compensation Quest appeared first on New Haven Independent.
